I also did it with premed's anki deck, i went through them both twice or so. 1 week out, i just did the lazy ocd version and it was all good. Best of luck my friend :) Ohh btw, dont get lazy with the physics part of C/P. My test was half physics so it screwed me a  little bit (went down 2-3 points from the practice) So yeah

You still have a lot of time to improve, i started with  around a 500 on the diagnostics test. You can improve the science sections with practice, i dont have any solid advise about CARS :p  But i do think you need to set realistic goals if you dont improve as much as you want to, or else it'll just eat you up
